method: corpus-blind controlled generator; 38 practical/natural/physical cross-domain cases

cases.knowledge_need: How a loaded sledge behaves when one runner rides onto wind-packed snow while the other remains in loose drift.
cases.circumstances: a crosswind has filled the ruts at sunset
cases.situation: He must keep the horse and cargo from overturning before reaching a shelter.

cases.knowledge_need: How to judge whether a shallow pond's ice is weakened by reeds, springs, and recent thaw.
cases.circumstances: cattle tracks lead across snow-covered ice
cases.situation: He wants to shorten the route home before dark.

cases.knowledge_need: How fog, current, and a low dawn sun change the ability to find a familiar landing from a small boat.
cases.circumstances: mist covers both banks after a cold night
cases.situation: His net boat is drifting toward deeper current.

cases.knowledge_need: How to cross a sedge marsh after rain without trusting grass that conceals waterlogged peat.
cases.circumstances: a usual footbridge has washed away
cases.situation: She is carrying a basket and must avoid becoming stuck alone.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a clay bank slumps after prolonged rain and how to cut a drainage channel without standing below it.
cases.circumstances: roof runoff has soaked the slope for three days
cases.situation: The shed wall at its base is beginning to lean.

cases.knowledge_need: How surface runoff after spring flooding can foul a shallow well and what signs make its water unsuitable to drink.
cases.circumstances: muddy water reached the well curb overnight
cases.situation: Several households need water for morning cooking.

cases.knowledge_need: How to start a cooking fire with damp outer fuel while keeping sparks from reaching dry bedding.
cases.circumstances: rain stopped shortly before nightfall
cases.situation: Her children need warm food and clothes dried safely.

cases.knowledge_need: Why smoke reverses down a chimney in still, cold weather and which changes reduce it without closing all ventilation.
cases.circumstances: a hard frost followed a damp evening
cases.situation: An infant is sleeping near the hearth while supper is prepared.

cases.knowledge_need: How uneven heating can warp a thin iron knife tang when a broken handle is being refitted.
cases.circumstances: only the tang must be warmed before fitting
cases.situation: The blade is needed for slaughtering at dawn.

cases.knowledge_need: How fresh lime reacts with water and why a covered container can become dangerously hot.
cases.circumstances: rain entered a sack of quicklime
cases.situation: He is deciding whether to move it beside stored straw.

cases.knowledge_need: How warmth and trapped moisture affect rye bread wrapped for a two-day journey.
cases.circumstances: loaves were baked before a wet warm spell
cases.situation: He must pack provisions that will remain edible on the road.

cases.knowledge_need: Why milk curdles unexpectedly after a pail was rinsed in hot water and left near a hearth.
cases.circumstances: morning milk is sour before cream has risen
cases.situation: She must separate what can still be used from what should be discarded.

cases.knowledge_need: How to dry damp grain after a roof leak without scorching it or trapping it in a mold-prone heap.
cases.circumstances: rain entered a bin during a night storm
cases.situation: Seed grain must be kept sound for spring sowing.

cases.knowledge_need: How late frost, dry wind, and exposed roots affect young cabbage seedlings moved from a warm bed.
cases.circumstances: clear weather follows transplanting
cases.situation: She has brushwood and water but cannot cover every row.

cases.knowledge_need: How to distinguish a safely usable stand of young nettles from plants growing beside a fouled path.
cases.circumstances: spring greens are scarce after winter
cases.situation: He wants leaves for a pot without gathering from contaminated ground.

cases.knowledge_need: How a mare with a newly born foal may react to strangers, dogs, and a narrow stable doorway.
cases.circumstances: the foal has backed itself against a wall
cases.situation: He must bring feed in without provoking a kick or separating them.

cases.knowledge_need: Why hens stop using a nest after mites or damp litter appear and how to handle eggs already laid there.
cases.circumstances: several hens are restless and pecking
cases.situation: Eggs are needed for market within two days.

cases.knowledge_need: How a loose horseshoe changes a horse's gait and why continuing on stony ground can damage the hoof.
cases.circumstances: one nail has risen and the shoe clicks
cases.situation: A loaded wagon still has several versts to travel.

cases.knowledge_need: How to respond when a worker becomes dizzy, flushed, and weak while hauling hay in midday heat.
cases.circumstances: he has worked without drinking since morning
cases.situation: Companions must decide whether shade, water, or urgent help is needed.

cases.knowledge_need: How numb pale fingers after handling wet rope in wind differ from hands merely made stiff by cold.
cases.circumstances: he has pulled a boat clear of shore ice
cases.situation: A brazier is available but he must avoid harming his hands while warming them.

cases.knowledge_need: How to deal with a puncture from a rusty fish hook that remains partly embedded in a finger.
cases.circumstances: the hook caught while pulling a line in cold rain
cases.situation: He must decide whether to continue work or seek help promptly.

cases.knowledge_need: How cold damp air and smoke affect a cough with fever, and why heavy work may worsen weakness.
cases.circumstances: he has coughed through two nights beside a smoky stove
cases.situation: His companions expect him to carry goods to market at dawn.

cases.knowledge_need: How moonless cloud cover, snow glare from earlier daylight, and lantern placement affect night travel on uneven ground.
cases.circumstances: a lantern's flame is dimming in wind
cases.situation: She must reach a labouring woman without falling into a ditch.

cases.knowledge_need: How a sudden fall in wind, a halo around the moon, and rising dampness can affect plans to cross open water.
cases.circumstances: boat is loaded but clouds are thickening after sunset
cases.situation: The crew must decide whether conditions are changing too quickly to depart.

cases.knowledge_need: How water temperature, spawning behavior, and a fast spring current change where fish may hold near shore.
cases.circumstances: usual net sets have been empty since the melt began
cases.situation: He has limited daylight to choose a new place without blocking the channel.

cases.knowledge_need: How wet hemp rope loses handling quality and how a sharp beam edge concentrates load when lowering a barrel.
cases.circumstances: rain has soaked the hoist line and barrel is full of salt
cases.situation: Two workers must lower it without a dropped load or broken rope.

cases.knowledge_need: How frost heave and saturated ground can shift a small timber porch away from its house wall.
cases.circumstances: door now sticks after repeated thaws
cases.situation: Residents need a safe entrance before another freeze.

cases.knowledge_need: How to find and repair a leak caused by capillary water running along flattened thatch rather than a visible hole.
cases.circumstances: drips appear only during windless steady rain
cases.situation: Bedding below must stay dry through the coming night.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a wet wooden plank seam opens after a boat is hauled into sun and how to manage it before relaunching.
cases.circumstances: one seam now admits a thin stream of water
cases.situation: Passengers are waiting for an afternoon crossing.

cases.knowledge_need: How axle lubrication, wheel hub heat, and a binding brake can lead to a sudden wheel failure on a descent.
cases.location: rutted road descending to a ford
cases.circumstances: a hub smells hot after a long haul
cases.situation: He is carrying jars that will break if the cart jolts violently.

cases.knowledge_need: How to mend a torn leather strap where repeated bending will reopen a stiff repair.
cases.circumstances: tear lies beside a buckle hole on a wet collar strap
cases.situation: A farmer needs the harness for tomorrow's ploughing.

cases.knowledge_need: How grain direction and hidden knots affect splitting a green oak wedge for a gate repair.
cases.circumstances: available wood was cut after a storm
cases.situation: He must make a strong wedge before cattle are driven through.

cases.knowledge_need: How a hairline crack in a glazed storage jar changes when it is filled with warm liquid.
cases.circumstances: jar was brought from a cold cellar
cases.situation: He must prevent a full vessel from failing during a batch.

cases.knowledge_need: Why wood ash lye can irritate skin and how its strength changes when ash has been rained on.
cases.circumstances: she is preparing wash water after a storm
cases.situation: Linen is dirty but her hands are already chapped.

cases.knowledge_need: How to protect smoked meat from flies and rodents when a warm spell arrives before it is fully dried.
cases.circumstances: the door latch broke overnight
cases.situation: Meat prepared for market must remain usable until repairs are made.

cases.knowledge_need: How rain-softened dead branches and gusting wind change the risk of sheltering under an old spruce.
cases.circumstances: thunder is approaching and the ground is muddy
cases.situation: She must choose a place to wait without exposure to falling wood or lightning.

cases.knowledge_need: How smoke, wind, and nearby standing water influence biting insects around a summer camp.
cases.circumstances: animals are restless near dusk
cases.situation: He needs a resting place that will not drive the flock into the water.

cases.knowledge_need: How to respond when a clay floor near a hearth suddenly becomes soft and sinks after a hidden water leak.
cases.circumstances: a water barrel has been dripping behind the oven for weeks
cases.situation: Hot embers and heavy dough troughs must be moved before the floor gives way further.
